assertions: All primary workspace routes render with zero console errors, zero uncaught page errors, and zero React hydration mismatches
All four domain modules report healthy or explicitly recoverable status in /api/readiness
Interactive flows verified via kimi-webbridge snapshot (@e refs) + network trace + screenshot visually inspected
Narrow viewport and keyboard navigation remain usable
Built with local Cargo profile without breaking /Applications/Muteki.app
Launched dev binary with verified state dir and backend/UI ports (never targeting installed /Applications/Muteki.app PID)
Window discovered via list_apps/list_windows, UI tree inspected via get_window_state, interactive flow executed via run_steps/element_token and confirmed via verify_state
Spawned dev server and desktop window terminated cleanly after end_session; .state and installed App remain uncorrupted

triggers.reason: UI route/component/style changes affect both Web UI and Desktop WKWebView shell
checklist: Web (kimi-webbridge): verify changed routes render with zero console/hydration errors, clean narrow layout, and valid screenshot
Desktop (cua-driver): verify dev NSH desktop window loads updated frontend and key controls respond via element_token

triggers.reason: Frontend reducers, roster logic, and client helpers govern streaming state
checklist: Verify fast-check state invariants pass and live Web UI reflects state transitions via kimi-webbridge snapshot + network

triggers.reason: API schema or handler changes must stay in sync with OpenAPI TypeScript contracts
checklist: Confirm generate_frontend_contracts.py --check passes and live Web calls match expected HTTP status/payloads in kimi-webbridge network

triggers.reason: Historical rule: attachments must never be concatenated into user prompt text or escape .muteki/attachments
checklist: Verify text-only, attachment-only, and text+attachment sends keep prompt text strictly equal to unattached input and attachments deliverable via independent channel

triggers.reason: Historical rule: built-in browser/tools must allow Muteki workbench loopback access under default config without weakening cross-origin bounds
checklist: Verify loopback workbench self-access succeeds under default settings (no extra env flags) while non-loopback origins stay blocked unless authorized

triggers.reason: Historical rule: existing SQLite records and legacy transcripts without new fields must load safely
checklist: Verify both fresh MUTEKI_STATE_DIR initialization and existing .state inheritance/readback without modifying installed App data

triggers.reason: Native macOS NSH shell changes cannot be validated in Web browser alone
checklist: Build local profile, launch dev desktop isolated from /Applications/Muteki.app, verify window state & controls via cua-driver, and verify clean exit

triggers.reason: Runtime/AGY/subagent orchestration requires verifying real execution receipts, cancel/exit cleanup, and UI reflection
checklist: Verify real configured model/runtime lifecycle (including AGY native idle/cancel/exit if touched) and inspect actual tool receipts + UI status

triggers.reason: Runner/container limits and image capabilities require real container/IPC verification
checklist: Run targeted scripts/verify_*.py (and verify_worker_image.sh if docker/worker changed) in isolated temp state without stopping unrelated containers

triggers.reason: Build/launch/install scripts directly govern port ownership, .state inheritance, and isolated verification
checklist: Verify dev Web (kimi-webbridge) and dev Desktop (cua-driver) startup, port/process ownership check, and MUTEKI_STATE_DIR isolation

triggers.reason: Server or dependency changes must compile cleanly and pass property + API smoke checks
checklist: Verify muteki-server starts on isolated state/port and /api/readiness reports ready=true via kimi-webbridge

triggers.reason: Changes to verification rules, hooks, or gates require full-matrix validation and careful human review
checklist: Run full automated suite + Web (kimi-webbridge) + Desktop (cua-driver) smoke verification and document gate/rule diffs
